sources.title: July 2026 Property Insurance Stability Report
sources.evidenceNote: Read pages 19-20, premium methodology: MIR as of March 31 2026, not entire first half; average homeowners including wind down in 51 counties from January report. County table: Escambia $3,702; Santa Rosa $3,512 including wind. Separate nonwind and condominium columns. Average premium varies with company, insured value, deductible and terms.

sources.title: Flood coverage requirements
sources.evidenceNote: Read outside-SFHA schedule: January 1 2026 Coverage A $400,000 threshold; January 1 2027 all values for applicable personal residential wind policies. SFHA rule already applies. Condo unit-owner, tenant contents and wind-excluded exceptions retained; agent must confirm applicability.

sources.title: Florida hurricane deductible
sources.evidenceNote: Read percentage deductible applied to insured dwelling limit rather than claim or purchase price, annual same-insurer conditions, inflation guard and surplus-lines qualification. Example here only illustrates percentage math; no claim that every policy has same deductible.

sources.title: Flood insurance eligibility
sources.evidenceNote: Read most homeowners policies do not cover flood damage, lender and SFHA requirement, lender may require outside high-risk area. No claim that low mapped risk means no flood risk.
